plain: Low, humble work, often thought unworthy of respect

webster.text: Pertaining to servants, or domestic servants; low; mean.

example.quote: Their menial servants may enter, may break locks, bars, and everything in their way; and whether they break through malice or revenge, no man, no court can inquire.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
